items.body_excerpt:
Vivid memory of my folks at a holiday party for grown-ups at the neighbors’ house. Brought me, at age 7, and let me watch football by myself in the front room (a sign of things to come).

After the Hail Mary, I ran and got my dad to come watch the replay.
